changelog: **Group sessions, mail (#1856, 4/4):** a waitlist promotion and a cancelled session are now also mailed through `sendEmail()` (`sendGroupEventEmail()`, category `meeting-invite`, EN/TR/DE `notifications.groupEventEmail`), on the recipient's clock and in their language, with a link to the session for a promotion. A publish stays in-app only.

en: When a place opens up in a full group session, the first person on the waitlist now also gets an e-mail — and everyone registered is e-mailed if the session is cancelled.
tr: Dolu bir grup oturumunda yer açılınca yedek listedeki ilk kişiye artık e-posta da gidiyor; oturum iptal edilirse kayıtlı herkese e-posta gönderiliyor.
de: Wird in einer vollen Gruppensitzung ein Platz frei, bekommt die erste Person auf der Warteliste jetzt auch eine E-Mail — und alle Angemeldeten werden per E-Mail informiert, wenn die Sitzung abgesagt wird.
